purpose: Document primary local registry/custody evidence and bounded anonymous full-geometry discovery.
assessment: The assessor confirms local tax-map custody and public paper-map service, but not a public feature service for full parcel polygons. NAMRIA/Geoportal material is source-ground context only; no city physical cadastral layer was verified. No polygon query was made.
registryAssessment: The official City Assessor describes permanent local real-property assessment records, tax mapping of all 98 barangays, parcel/property index numbers, and public issuance of tax maps. This is municipal assessment-cadastre custody, not proof of the legal title registry or a full open parcel vector layer.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official City Assessor page: permanent property records, tax-mapping division, barangay maps, section-index maps, parcel/property index numbers, and property-location services.
Official 2026 City Citizen’s Charter describes public issuance of tax maps through the City Assessor Tax Mapping Division; request workflow is document-based.
Official city map page; a municipal map link alone is not treated as parcel-vector evidence.
